observation: A shared subject-and-anchor implementation now displays placement measurements through selection in the live app, portable viewer and fallback; a synthetic project uses the same path.
cause: A size-only scene and owner-equality filtering could not represent inter-object or datum relationships.
proposed_rule: Treat relationship dimensions as shared project annotations, not customer-specific UI patches. Resolve current anchors, prioritize relationships on selection, keep camera alignment explicit, separate size display, preserve uncertainty per measurement and verify actual cross-consumer output without display revisions.
limits: Synthetic reuse does not prove automatic interpretation of another customer PDF. Physical-phone opening was not tested. Keep view mappings, fixture IDs, coordinates and measured values in project data.
